Maya (People Ops): quick q for the group 1 Chris is planning to return from parental leave earlier than their LOA end and wants a phased 3-week ramp (20h, 30h, full). what forms do we need + any payroll/benefits impacts?

Sofia (HR Benefits): short answer: updated leave return form with the phased schedule, a provider note if medical-related, and election for benefits continuation during reduced hours. benefits remain active if employer-paid portion continues; employee premium proration depends on payroll earnings.

Chris (NewParent): hi all 1 thanks. also: will my 401k contributions resume automatically? and do i keep my laptop stipend if i'm part-time?

Tom (Payroll): 401k salary deferrals stop when there are no earnings. if you have partial pay we'll process deferrals on the paid earnings automatically. employer match follows plan terms; i'll send the exact matching rules to you. laptop stipend is handled by Finance/AssetMgmt 1 part-time doesn't remove prior reimbursements but check with Finance if there are pro-rata policies.

Devon (Eng Manager): on the ops side please mark "reduced hours" in the return plan so oncall is paused and meeting invites adjust. i'll take the first two weeks of oncall and split PR review with Priya.

Sofia (HR Benefits): also flag: if you want to convert remaining parental days to intermittent to cover medical appointments, we can do that on the updated form. COBRA-like continuation only applies if you go unpaid and opt out of active coverage.

Chris (NewParent): thanks. i need to know cutoff dates for payroll so I can avoid retro adjustments.

Tom (Payroll): payroll cutoff is 4 business days before pay run. if we get updates after cutoff we'll do a retro, but it can delay reimbursements by 1-2 cycles. submit updated return via HR portal or email payroll@redwood-inference.com.

Maya (People Ops): checklist for Chris: 1) submit updated return form with phased hours; 2) upload any medical note if applicable; 3) indicate PTO conversion or intermittent preference; 4) confirm benefits choice; 5) manager to post ramp schedule in the team calendar. i'll triage as soon as the form lands.

BenefitsBot: Reminder 1 Please upload leave changes at https://hr.redwood-inference.com/leaves. Payroll cutoff in 4 business days for pay period ending 1790123600.

Devon (Eng Manager): small extra: hardware return 1 if you need the company laptop longer while ramping, file a short-term equipment request and I'll approve.

Chris (NewParent): uploaded the form and noted phased hours. opting to keep benefits active and to resume 401k when payroll shows earnings. thanks everyone.

Tom (Payroll): got it, we'll queue the payroll adjustments. i'll post confirmation once next run completes.

Maya (People Ops): thanks team. keeping updates here so HR has a single thread. if anything changes tag me directly. :heart:
